This '''spiny creature''' lived on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. It had a long, tapered [[Nose/Legends|snout]], pointy [[Ear/Legends|ears]], and climbed on [[Limb/Legends|all fours]]. The creature had [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Hair/Legends|fu]]r with a white stripe down the center. It had a large, gray shell with white spines on it. This [[Species/Legends| animal]] was arboreal, able to climb [[Tree/Legends|trees]] with ease.<ref name="JML" />

[[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]] once had a painful encounter with one of these creatures while taking his skills test to become a [[Soldier/Legends|warrior]]. When Warrick was blasted with bad luck from a [[Teebo's lucksprite|lucksprite]], he grabbed the spiked creature rather than the doll he had intended to grab. The spikes caused Warrick to fall from the tree and fail his test.<ref name="JML" />
